ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the raw report was ingested into the dashboard by the collector

reportName.description: Name of the source report file from which this record was extracted

reportFolder.description: Folder or path of the source report file from which this record was extracted

product_id.description: Product identifier from the CreoDIAS interface (OData Id)

product_name.description: Product file name from the CreoDIAS interface (OData Name)

content_length.description: Product file size in bytes (OData ContentLength)

ingestion_date.description: Date the product was ingested into the CreoDIAS interface (IngestionDate)

publication_date.description: Date the product was published on the CreoDIAS interface (PublicationDate)

modification_date.description: Last modification date of the product on the CreoDIAS interface (ModificationDate)

origin_date.description: Product origin date at the source (OriginDate)

interface_name.description: Name of the CreoDIAS interface instance the product was collected from

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the product (DD)

production_service_name.description: Name of the CreoDIAS production service instance providing the product

footprint.description: Geographic footprint of the product as reported by the CreoDIAS interface

online.description: Whether the product is currently online and available for download on the CreoDIAS interface

s3_path.description: Path of the product in the CreoDIAS S3 object storage
